subject: Maths
title: Short multiplication
subtitle: Multiplication and Division (Times Tables to 12×12) · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can multiply a multi-digit number by a single digit using short multiplication.

key_vocab.definition: Short multiplication is the column method for multi-digit × SINGLE-digit. Multiply each digit, carry tens to the next column.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can multiply a multi-digit number by a single digit using short multiplication.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Short multiplication -- Short multiplication is the column method for multi-digit × SINGLE-digit. Multiply each digit, carry tens to the next column.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiply each digit (right to left). If the result is 10+, write the units and CARRY the tens to the next column.
47 × 8 = 376
8×7=56, write 6 carry 5; then 8×4+5=37

Key examples:
  ✓ 234 × 6 = 1404  (with carrying)
  ✓ Carry tens to next column  (left-shift)
  ✓ 47 × 8 = 376  (2-digit)
  ✗ Forget to add the carry  (answer wrong)
  ✗ Multiply right to left  (actually right-to-left IS correct!)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – no carry
  Calculate 32 × 3
  3 × 2 = 6 (units)
  3 × 3 = 9 (tens)
  Read off: 96
  = 96
  (No carrying needed because each multiplication is < 10.)

Example 2 – single carry
  Calculate 47 × 8
  8 × 7 = 56 (write 6, carry 5)
  8 × 4 = 32, +5 = 37
  Read off: 376
  = 376
  (Always work right to left, carrying any tens.)

sections.title: With carrying
sections.content:
Carry the tens to the next column.

(a) 47 × 8
(b) 56 × 7
(c) 83 × 6
(d) 94 × 5

sections.title: With zero in number
sections.content:
Don't forget: 0 × n = 0, plus any carry.

(a) 305 × 7
(b) 402 × 8
(c) 709 × 6
(d) 5006 × 4

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Multiply right to left
✓ Carries are added to the NEXT column's product
✗ 47 × 8 = 326 (forget carry)
✗ 0 × n = 0, ignore the carry
✓ Short multiplication only works for single-digit multipliers
